children.text: These rules may be called the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
They shall come into force on the 1st day of April, 2011.
'Act' means the Legal Metrology Act, 2009;
'combination package' means a package containing two or more individual packages of different commodities;
'dealer' means a person who carries on directly or otherwise the business of buying, selling, supplying or distributing;
'group package' means a package containing two or more individual packages of the same commodity;
'maximum permissible error' means error in deficiency specified in First Schedule;
'net quantity' means quantity of commodity contained excluding wrapper/container;
'principal display panel' means total surface area of package where declarations are given;
'retail package' means packages intended for retail sale;
'retail sale price' means maximum price sold inclusive of all taxes.

children.title: Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale

children.text: Packages containing net quantity of more than 25 kg or 25 litre;
Cement, fertilizer and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kg;
Packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers.

children.title: Regulation for pre-packing and sale of commodities

children.text: No person shall pre-pack or sell any pre-packed commodity unless it bears mandatory declarations.
Prescribed standard packages in Second Schedule (Omitted by 2021 amendment).

children.title: Declarations to be made on every package

children.text: Name and complete address of manufacturer/packer/importer.
Country of origin (Inserted by 2017 Amendment).
Common or generic name of commodity.
Net quantity in standard unit.
Month and year of manufacture/packing/import.
Maximum Retail Price Rs. XX.XX inclusive of all taxes.
Unit Sale Price Rs. per unit/g/ml (Inserted by 2021 Amendment).
Consumer care name, address, phone and email address details.

children.title: Manner in which declaration shall be made

children.text: Height of numeral and letters as per Table-I minimums.
Principal Display Panel Area calculations.

children.title: Placement of declaration and clear space surround net quantity

children.text: Every declaration clear and legible.
Net quantity surrounding clear space padding.
